googling "liquidation author:lsj" didn't bring anything, so here goes :

Name: Liquidation

[Tenth:A/B]

Cardtype: Master

Master. Do not replace until your discard phase.

Burn seven cards from the top of your library to gain 3 pool.

Artist: James Stowe

You have 6 cards left in your library. You play Liquidation. What happens ?
1/ do you burn what's left of the library and no pool is gained ?
2/ or : you don't burn anything, since you're supposed to burn a "package"
of 7 cards (no more, no less) "to" gain the pool ? (the "to" thingy
implying it's a kind of cost?)
3/ you can't play Liquidation at all, since you can't do the "do X to do Y"
?

thanks
Stone

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:


IANLSJ, but you play it and attempt to burn 7 cards, so you burn 6
cards and since you failed to burn 7 cards then you fail to gain 3
pool.
